steps.eval: (()=>{const i=document.getElementById('v5-q');const out=[];for(const q of ["No weekends", "Weekdays before 11am", "Not after 10pm", "Mon-Wed 2pm to 5pm", "no fridays after 6pm", "sat after 9", "before 10 on mondays", "tuesdays", "between 9 and 11 on thu", "sunday mornings", "fri evenings", "late nights on weekends", "every day until noon", "thu-sun after 10:30pm", "can't work tues or thurs", "lunch on weekdays", "hello", "from 6pm to close fri", "mon", "weekend breakfast"]){i.value=q;i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));out.push(q+' => '+document.querySelector('[data-pv=v5-q]').innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' '));}console.error(out.join('\n'))})()
